title: Sıra Başı
author: Toprak Işık
description: Across eleven keenly observed stories, First in Line follows ordinary people at different stages of life as they struggle to appear disciplined, respectable, successful or simply in control -from a military-school cadet calculating the safest place in a punishment line and a student entrusting his future to a downloaded project to a young woman seeking a new life in Ankara and an unemployed graduate whose family is eager to arrange both his career and marriage. Speaking with unwavering self-confidence, the narrators attempt to justify their vanity, cowardice, jealousy and compromises, only to reveal precisely what they hope to conceal. Moving through military schools, campuses, family homes, workplaces and apartment blocks, this warm and darkly humorous collection offers a vivid panorama of Turkish society while exploring authority, masculinity, ambition, unemployment, family pressure, social status and the tensions between provincial and metropolitan life.
